description: This file implements the 'discover' command for the OpenClawMacCLI application on macOS. It defines options parsing, output data structures, and the main function to run network discovery of gateways, producing either JSON output or a human-readable report.

classes.name: DiscoveryOptions
classes.description: Represents command-line options for discovery with parsing logic.

classes.name: DiscoveryOutput
classes.description: Encodable struct for serializing discovery results, including gateway information.

classes.name: DiscoveryOutput.Gateway
classes.description: Represents individual gateway details for output.
